**[[United States Department of Defense|The Pentagon]] reports it has begun withdrawing U.S. troops from [[Syria]], with a spokesperson saying that the [[International military intervention against ISIL#3 December 2014|coalition]] has liberated [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]]-held territory but also that the campaign is not over. *[[2018 Kivu Ebola outbreak]]
**Over 300 people have died of [[Ebola]] in the [[Democratic Republic of Congo]] and the [[World Health Organization]] is concerned the outbreak is not being contained. [https://www.cnn.com/2018/12/18/health/ebola-democratic-republic-of-congo-intl/index.html (CNN)]
